notes: CRISPR Therapeutics AG is Swiss-domiciled but files a Form 10-K (not 20-F) as a U.S. domestic-reporting foreign private issuer that has elected/qualified to file 10-K. Calibration heuristic 2 (foreign-issuer caveat) does not apply punitively to this filer.

claims.claim_text: CASGEVY (exagamglogene autotemcel / exa-cel) is the first-ever approved CRISPR-based gene-editing therapy in the world, approved in the U.S., E.U., Great Britain, Canada, Switzerland and certain Middle East countries for eligible patients 12+ with severe sickle cell disease (SCD) or transfusion-dependent beta thalassemia (TDT). It is advanced under a joint development and commercialization agreement with Vertex Pharmaceuticals.
claims.subject: CRISPR Therapeutics AG
claims.object_value: CASGEVY / exa-cel / exagamglogene autotemcel; indications: SCD and TDT; multi-jurisdiction approvals
claims.source_quote: CASGEVY (exagamglogene autotemcel [exa-cel])... In 2023, CASGEVY became the first-ever approved CRISPR-based gene-editing therapy in the world. To date, CASGEVY has been approved in the United States, European Union, Great Britain, Canada, Switzerland and certain countries in the Middle East for the treatment of eligible patients 12 years and older with SCD or TDT.

claims.claim_text: CTX310 is an in vivo CRISPR/Cas9 LNP-delivered gene-editing candidate directed at ANGPTL3 currently in an ongoing Phase 1b clinical trial.
claims.subject: CRISPR Therapeutics AG
claims.object_value: CTX310 — Phase 1b, ANGPTL3 target, LNP delivery, cardiovascular
claims.source_quote: Our in vivo portfolio includes cardiovascular investigational programs, such as CTX310, directed towards angiopoietin-related protein 3 or ANGPTL3, which is currently in an ongoing Phase 1b clinical trial.

claims.claim_text: Zugocabtagene geleucel (zugo-cel / formerly CTX112) is an allogeneic CD19 CAR-T candidate manufactured at CRSP's internal GMP facility in Framingham, MA. It is in an ongoing Phase 1/2 oncology trial in relapsed/refractory B-cell malignancies and a Phase 1 autoimmune trial in SLE/systemic sclerosis/inflammatory myositis, has received FDA RMAT designation for relapsed/refractory follicular lymphoma and marginal zone lymphoma, and is being co-developed with Eli Lilly in combination with pirtobrutinib.

Zugo-cel has been granted RMAT designation by the U.S. Food and Drug Administration for the treatment of relapsed or refractory follicular lymphoma and marginal zone lymphoma... collaboration and clinical supply agreement with Eli Lilly to evaluate zugo-cel together with pirtobrutinib in aggressive B-cell lymphomas

Operating lease obligations on the Framingham cell-manufacturing site and Boston offices total $29.7M (within 1 year) and $235.9M (beyond 1 year) as of Dec 31, 2025.

claims.claim_text: As of Dec 31, 2025 CRSP held $1,975.8M in cash, cash equivalents and marketable securities and an accumulated deficit of $1,947.6M; FY2025 net cash used in operations was $345.0M, raising the going-concern look-through to roughly 5-6 years of runway, and CRSP funded itself via ATM (sold 6.1M shares at $59.63 = $359.0M in 2025) and a 2025 ATM ($42.3M raised, $557.2M remaining capacity).
